meta.scope: 30 min of continuous testing; e& mobile data 16:40–16:50; Etihad Rail Wi-Fi 16:50–17:10. 1,770 probes, 25 throughput tests, 31 radio samples, 896 location fixes.

findings: Fault domain is the Wi-Fi WAN/backhaul. The LAN gateway answered reliably while 31% of internet checks failed.
Mobile in parallel succeeded 99.3% of the time over the same minutes.
Stalls by phase: A 28% down; B 20% down; C 12% down.
Location coverage was 70%. Positions are missing or approximate for part of the route.

Next test: Keep recording until arrival; auto-stop only inside a station geofence.
Repeat at the same time of day with Wi-Fi-only and mobile-only legs.
Keep location on "Allow all the time" and the phone near a window; location coverage was low.
Escalate the Wi-Fi backhaul (WAN) with the operator: the LAN side was healthy.
